title: C112 — Ignition coil-on-plug 2
introduction:
A coil-on-plug ignition coil sits at its spark plug and produces the high voltage needed for the spark. This page identifies the coil connector, maps its cavities to circuits and provides a cross-reference for the listed pigtail service parts.

I use the cavity label as the link between drawing and table. Once I find the matching row, I read across to keep the circuit identity, color, gauge, function and terminal together. It is a little wiring address book: the cavity tells you where to look, while the Function entry tells you what the connection is there to do. The service-parts table serves a separate purpose, associating each listed kit with its service item and housing.

This guide covers reading the reference. Matching vehicle service information is needed for access, physical viewing direction, probing, wire selection or replacement. The Size code and gauge convention remain as printed, and this page supplies no electrical test or diagnosis.

edits.why: I navigate by the housing outline and the vertical stack of cavity labels. The middle circle is shaded, matching the unused middle position in the circuit table. Top, middle and bottom describe this printed drawing only; they do not establish vehicle location or a physical mating-side or wire-side viewing direction.

The upper drawn cavity corresponds to the powertrain control connection and the lower cavity to the fuse-or-circuit-breaker supply. The middle row has no assigned circuit. Read each row as a complete set of associated labels, including its terminal entry. The nominal pin count describes housing capacity, so an unassigned position is not evidence of a missing wire.

The kit Number, Service Part and Engineering Shell identify different things, and the rest of the row describes their listed association. I keep that distinction when reading the table: a familiar shell is not enough to choose a kit. The entries do not establish interchangeability or provide the cutting, splicing and installation steps for replacement.
